faq: Do I deal with IPO Pakistan directly?
No. Shine Legal Associates prepares and files on your behalf and keeps you updated.
How long do filings take?
It depends on the type of filing, the office's processing and any objections. Shine gives an estimate after reviewing your case.
Can one application cover everything?
Usually not. Trademarks, copyright and designs are separate rights with separate filings. Shine explains what each one protects.
What does it cost?
Fees depend on the filing type and the number of classes or works. You receive a written quote before anything is filed.

name: Trademark Registration
h1: Trademark Registration in Pakistan for Your Brand Name and Logo
metaTitle: Trademark Registration in Pakistan | NayaDaur Digital
metaDesc: Register your brand name, logo or slogan as a trademark in Pakistan. Search, filing and follow-up by Shine Legal Associates, arranged through NayaDaur Digital.
card: Register your brand name, logo or slogan so nobody else can use it.
alt: Glowing shield with a brand mark, a registered wax seal and a certificate
ur: اپنے برانڈ کا نام اور لوگو قانونی طور پر اپنے نام رجسٹر کروائیں۔
پہلے تلاش، پھر درست کلاس میں درخواست۔ پورا عمل شین لیگل ایسوسی ایٹس سنبھالتے ہیں۔
lead: A designed logo is not automatically a registered trademark. Registration is the legal step that gives you the right to stop others from using a confusingly similar name or logo.
includes: A check for identical or similar marks before you invest further in a name.
Your goods or services placed in the correct trademark classes.
Preparation and submission of the application for your name, logo or both.
Replies to objections and tracking of each stage.
Your registration record and a reminder before it needs renewing.
who: New brands choosing a name and logo
Shops, restaurants and online sellers growing beyond one city
Agencies whose clients have just received a new logo
steps: Check whether your mark is free to use and register.
Agree the mark, the classes and the quote in writing.
Your application is prepared and submitted.
Receive the certificate and renewal dates.
faq: Why register a trademark?
It gives you a stronger, clearer legal position against copycats than relying on use alone, and it is a real asset if you sell or franchise your brand.
Can I register a logo and a name?
Yes. They can be registered separately or together. Shine advises which route suits your brand.
Does registration work outside Pakistan?
No. Trademark rights are territorial. If you sell abroad, ask about filings in those countries.
Is acceptance guaranteed?
No. The office may raise objections, for example if a similar mark exists. A search first reduces that risk.
notIncluded: Logo design itself, which NayaDaur Digital can do separately

name: Copyright Legal Protection
h1: Copyright Protection for Designs, Content and Creative Work
metaTitle: Copyright Legal Protection in Pakistan | NayaDaur Digital
metaDesc: Protect original artwork, designs, content, photographs and software with copyright registration, ownership agreements and takedown support from Shine Legal Associates.
card: Protect your artwork, content, photos and software from being copied.
alt: Protective glass dome over a pen, brushes, camera and music note with a padlock
ur: آپ کا ڈیزائن، تحریر، تصویر اور سافٹ ویئر آپ کی ملکیت رہے۔
کاپی رائٹ ریکارڈ، معاہدے اور نقل کے خلاف کارروائی۔
lead: Creative work is valuable the moment it exists. Copyright protection helps you prove it is yours and act when someone copies it.
includes: An official record for original artwork, designs, written content, photographs, music and software.
Clear terms on who owns work made by designers, developers and freelancers.
Written permission for others to use your work, with limits you choose.
Formal notices and takedown requests when your work is copied.
Guidance on copyright notices and how to credit work correctly.
who: Designers, photographers and content creators
Businesses that commission logos, websites or software
Brands whose catalogues and product photos get copied
steps: List the work you want to protect.
Shine explains what is protected and what to register.
Applications and ownership paperwork are prepared.
Notices and licences are put in place.
Act on copies when they appear.
faq: Do I need to register copyright?
Protection generally arises when original work is created, but a registration gives you an official record that is useful as evidence. Shine confirms what applies to your work.
Does copyright protect a brand name?
Not usually. Names and logos used as brand identifiers are normally protected as trademarks. Shine can advise on both.
Who owns a logo or website I paid for?
It depends on the agreement. A written assignment makes ownership clear.
Can copied content be removed?
Often yes, through notices to the website, platform or seller. Results depend on the case.
notIncluded: Registration of brand names, which is a trademark matter
